summary.text: Mike Moffett is a Republican state representative from Merrimack 4 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve, reaching the rank of lieutenant colonel, and has worked as a professor at New Hampshire Technical Institute, an author and a columnist.

paragraphs.text: Michael Moffett graduated from Groveton High School in 1973 and served in the U.S. Marine Corps Reserve, reaching the rank of lieutenant colonel.
He earned a graduate degree in education and has worked as a professor at New Hampshire Technical Institute, an author and a columnist.
Moffett previously represented Merrimack 9 in the New Hampshire House from 2016 to 2018, and his current tenure, representing Merrimack 4, began in 2020.

In the 2023-2024 session he chaired the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee, and in 2021-2022 he served on the House Education Committee and as vice-chair of the State-Federal Relations and Veterans Affairs Committee.
